channel.title: Chepatapa Apps — Build Log
channel.description: How Chepatapa Apps' five products get built by one developer sharing a single Flutter SDK and an AI-assisted, spec-driven workflow.

item.title: Kin Compass submitted for App Store review
item.description: Kin Compass, the daily routines and communication scripts app for parents of preschoolers with ADHD, has been submitted for Apple App Store review.

item.title: Bloomelle started
item.description: Bloomelle, a menstrual cycle-phase planning coach, started development — scaffolded from Flare's skeleton like Kin Compass before it.

item.title: Flare live on the iOS App Store
item.description: Flare, the hot flash and night sweat tracker, went live on the iOS App Store.

item.title: Perchly started
item.description: Perchly, a private Swift Package Manager registry, started development, reusing Publy's org/auth/billing layer.

item.title: Publy started
item.description: Publy, a private Dart and Flutter package registry, started development.

item.title: Kin Compass started
item.description: Kin Compass started development, cloned from Flare's skeleton.

item.title: This site goes up
